_doc: Koi Blossom engine trial (tag koi, 2026-10-20): the same gates as the Castle bench (engine/digitize/bench.py) on the FR upper panel that the close-up covers. Garment mm on the FR piece (wearer's right front), size M: x from CF (+ = wearer's left, so FR is x < 0), y from the CF neck seam. Crop = the largest box inside the close-up's registered region at feather weight > 0.6 (register.crop_inside 0.797): 170 x 270 mm, holding both close-up lilies, the leaves / vines under them, floating petals and the four close-up fish. The close-up's own frame is rotated against the garment, so a 200 x 200 square does not fit inside it at weight 0.6 (x -235..-35 reads 0.0). The delivered Rev B FR file is scored on exactly this crop (baseline_dst: a git-ignored copy in out/revB/, origin aligned on the Rev C build's recorded origin, bench/TRIAL.md).
